comparison_rule: Strict type-preserving full JSON equality and exact serialized semantic SHA-256; no ignored field within the semantic projection.
excluded_private_context: old run observations/history; the exact complete semantic reference is separately supplied
expected_nonsemantic_changes: New package identity, documentation, licenses and source/provenance inventory.
Public pre-run freeze and new execution observations.
Run timestamps, runtime/platform strings, process timing, output paths and declared worker count.
Execution-observation's packaged Python file inventory includes new helper files; it is not a dynamic import trace.
failure_rule: An unexpected difference fails. Preserve the failed result and the preregistration; introduce a new candidate/freeze before any changed rerun.
unchanged: All source envelopes, native readers and published TXT
Profile and policies including historical status and fixed scenario date
Producer, HOF evaluator, recipient, native baseline and retained runner
